questions.question: S1
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff >=7/8 of the frozen P3 Gaussian cells agree within 3 combined SE; REJECTED iff <=4/8; else INCONCLUSIVE

questions.question: S2
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff >=5/6 P4 m=1 CUSUM cells agree within 3 combined SE AND the independent score implementation matches P4 to 1e-12

questions.question: S3
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff every measured in-control ARL is within 1% of the frozen target

questions.question: S4
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff E[eps psi]=1, E[psi]=0 and the Fisher information reproduce Stage-D within the frozen tolerances for all six families

questions.question: S5
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff every non-Gaussian SR threshold is accepted on a held-out sample within 0.5% under the frozen search/verify/retry ladder

questions.question: S6
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff the lower 95% bound of Gamma_A exceeds 2.0 in every eligible (D,f,m) cell; the moment-marginal family ('t3',) is reported in full and never counted either way

questions.question: S7
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff the relative spread of K(D,f,m)=rho_c(m)/rho_c(1) across the 10 eligible (D,f) cells is <= 0.1 for every m in (2, 3, 5)

questions.question: S7D
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff |K(cusum,f,m)/K(sr,f,m) - 1| <= 0.03 for all eligible f and m in (2, 3, 5)

questions.question: S7F
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff, for each detector, the spread of K across the eligible families is <= 0.1 for every m in (2, 3, 5)

questions.question: S7X
questions.frozen_rule: m in (10, 20) lies outside P3's supported window grid.  Frozen before results as EXTRAPOLATION_BEYOND_P3: reported, never gated, never used to support or reject the window law

questions.question: S8
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff max_batch |Gamma_A(m) - (1/m) sum_r gamma_r - R_m| <= 1e-09 in every cell.  This is an EXACT algebraic identity summed in two different orders, so the test is absolute, not statistical.

questions.question: S9
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff |(Gamma_A - Gamma_B) - R_m| <= 1e-12 in every cell and P(tau<m) is present

questions.question: S10
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff P7's boundary criterion reproduces in >= 5 of 6 families on the declared sub-family grid (detector x m in {1,5}) and metric set ('arl', 'ref_mse', 'fap100', 'e_acf1').  This is P7's criterion applied to a DECLARED SUBSET of P7's coverage, not verbatim P7 coverage; the subset was frozen before results.

uncertainty_companion.note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; never part of the gate

questions.question: S11
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff the chain ARL at rho=1 is below 50% of the same-cell nominal ARL_0 in every declared (D,f,m) cell

questions.question: S12
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff the paired 95% CI of Gamma_A(cusum)/Gamma_A(sr) contains 1 in >=90% of the (f,m) comparisons; REJECTED iff it excludes 1 in >=90%; else INCONCLUSIVE.  Intervals use the CRN-paired linearised SE, never an independent-SE formula.

questions.question: S13
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff E1 and E5 agree within 3 combined SE in >= 90% of all cells and >= 95% of the non-('t3',) cells

questions.question: S14
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff all 24 declared drift rows per non-excluded (D,f) cell are reported, each with its q50, q95, P(delay>100) and an explicit tail label

questions.question: S15
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED (attraction established) iff the upper 95% bound of Gamma_A at t3/m=20 lies below 2 in E1 AND E5 AND the independent reimplementation.  Anything else is INCONCLUSIVE: a point estimate below 2 is not evidence of attraction, and m=20 is outside P3's supported window grid in any case.

questions.question: S16
questions.frozen_rule: The frozen decision table: agreeing with P7 while sitting systematically below P3 at every m is KNOWN_PREEXISTING_DISCREPANCY (P8R neither owns nor resolves the P3 numbers); agreeing with neither is a NEW_DEFECT_CANDIDATE and REJECTS this question.

questions.question: S17
questions.frozen_rule: SUPPORTED iff at most 1 of the representative cells of the independent reimplementation exceeds 3.0 combined SE against production
